profile_text.body:
Palantir describes itself as a company that builds software to empower organizations to effectively integrate their data, decisions, and operations. Its website carries the tagline "Foundational Software of Tomorrow. Delivered Today."

Its AI product, Palantir AIP, is categorized under Data & Analytics AI and described as an enterprise AI platform with Ontology-based governance, a defense/intel focus, and high-stakes decision influence.

Palantir is a for-profit public company founded in 2003, headquartered in Palo Alto, with ticker PLTR and CIK 0001321655. A case captioned Haugland v. Anthropic PBC appears in the District Court, D. Delaware.
